proposal.headline: Extend axial tightening northwest to lengthen the older-rock core
proposal.observation: The prediction's narrow older-rock core begins farther southeast than the observed dark inner bedrock belt, leaving a broad pale-blue nose in the northwestern quarter. The outer southwestern green belt and much of the northeastern yellow cover already agree with the target.
proposal.expected_effect: Extend older-unit exposures northwest within the existing fold envelope, reducing the pale-blue excess at the nose while largely preserving outer contacts and young cover.
